sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and face opponents struggling near the foot of the table with just one win from their last ten matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host Dawley Town in a fixture that could have implications for the title race, with Stafford looking to close the gap on leaders Sandbach following a recent draw. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form after recent victories, entertain Eccleshall who occupy fifth place but have lost their last match. Wolverhampton Casuals—level on points with Bridgnorth—welcome Wednesfield Community in a local clash. Bilston Town, sixth and on a run of strong results, host Foley Meir in a mid-table encounter. At the bottom of the division, Widnes Town travel to Brereton Social, while Telford Town face Cheadle Heath Nomads in a fixture between two of the division's poorest performers. New Mills host Market Drayton Town in a basement battle, and Crewe welcome Allscott Heath in another contest involving struggling sides. Shawbury United host Barnton in a tie between teams in the lower half.
